headline: Essex Property Trust (NYSE:ESS) Beats Core FFO Estimates and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Essex Property Trust Q2 core FFO beat estimates at $4.08/share, revenue slightly below. Raised full-year guidance, strong occupancy 96.3%, led by Northern California growth.

headline: Essex Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance
summary: SAN MATEO, Calif., July 29, 2026--Essex Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE: ESS) (the "Company") announced today its second quarter 2026 earnings results and related business activities.
